class.name: WarmRequest
class.brief_description: A single table's cache-warming intent, produced by a [WarmPolicy].
class.description: A request is a value naming what a write-behind backend should pre-load for one table. Synchronous backends ignore it. [member kind] decides which of [member id_list] or [member filter_map] carries the scope, and the four static factories are the only way to get a request whose scope and kind agree. [codeblock] # Warm everything in the table: WarmRequest.all() # Warm a known set of records: WarmRequest.ids([&"valeria", &"jose"]) # Warm by a column filter: WarmRequest.filter({ &"online": true }) # Warm nothing eagerly (lazy fetch-on-miss still applies): WarmRequest.none() [/codeblock] Calling [code]new()[/code] instead gives the same request [method none] returns.

method.name: all
method.description: Returns a request that warms every record in the table.

method.name: filter
method.description: Returns a request that warms every record matching [param map], copied into [member filter_map] so a later edit of [param map] cannot change what was planned.

method.name: ids
method.description: Returns a request that warms the records named in [param values]. Each entry is read as a [StringName] into [member id_list].

method.name: none
method.description: Returns a request that warms nothing. Lazy fetch-on-miss still covers reads.

members.member: The column filter to warm when [member kind] is [constant KIND_FILTER].
The record ids to warm when [member kind] is [constant KIND_IDS].

constants.constant: Warm nothing. Records load lazily on first miss.
Warm every record in the table.
